channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Bayfront Medical Building (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The Bayfront Medical Building's opening was shown as August 27, 2024. The only article that could be read was published the day before and gives that day as the scheduled first day for patients, so the opening is now shown as August 2024 and the open questions list the sources that could not be read.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The Bayfront Medical Building page no longer states one floor area, because sources give 181,000 to 190,000 sq ft; it lists them instead. It describes Clark as leading the construction team rather than as general contractor, cites post-opening articles for the August 2024 opening, and drops an unsourced total-cost figure.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The construction start now reads September 2021, from Clark's September 23, 2021 groundbreaking release, instead of October 2, 2021, which is only the date of SF YIMBY's article. The $228 million figure no longer says it covers the building alone: Commercial Property Executive does not say whether it includes the garage. The May 2020 Regents milestone now says the committee's agenda lists the Block 34 items for action, since the outcome was not shown by a source read, and cites the agenda. The record now separates the building's address (520 Illinois St, per CPE) from the Block 34 corner of 3rd and Mariposa and no longer quotes a UCSF project name that no readable source gives. Address, size, story count, architect, contractor and opening date are cited to CPE, SF YIMBY and Clark because UCSF Real Estate's page could not be read. The Wikimedia photo credit no longer names a flight the file page does not state.

item.title: Complete · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building opens to patients in August 2024. Hospital Management's article of August 26, 2024, written the day before, says the building is "due to start receiving patients on 27 August" (a scheduled date, not a confirmed one). Healthcare Facilities Today (August 29, 2024) writes "UCSF is celebrating the opening of the UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building", and Stantec's release (September 17, 2024) writes "Recently, the UCSF Bayfront Medical Building opened its doors"; neither gives the opening day, so only the month is shown (~2024)
item.description: UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building opens to patients in August 2024. Healthcare Facilities Today (August 29, 2024) writes "UCSF is celebrating the opening of the UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building", and Stantec's release (September 17, 2024) writes "Recently, the UCSF Bayfront Medical Building opened its doors"; neither gives the opening day, so only the month is shown (~2024). Source: Hospital Management (hospitalmanagement.net), 2024-08-26; Healthcare Facilities Today, 2024-08-29; Stantec, 2024-09-17.

item.title: Milestone · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: Construction of the Block 34 clinical building begins: Clark announces on September 23, 2021 that it has broken ground (SF YIMBY reported on October 2, 2021 that crews had started) (~2021)
item.description: Construction of the Block 34 clinical building begins: Clark announces on September 23, 2021 that it has broken ground (SF YIMBY reported on October 2, 2021 that crews had started) (~2021). Source: Clark Construction Group (general contractor's own press release), 2021-09-23; San Francisco YIMBY, 2021-10.
